propositions: CodeQL scan flags false positives in docs/experiments/ files that are not shipped in production packages and generate recurring noise on every push.
A durable exclusion mechanism is needed to prevent future docs/ additions from triggering recurring CodeQL alerts rather than relying on per-alert dismissals.
A CodeQL config file with paths-ignore directive must be created and wired into the workflow init step to exclude docs/** from analysis.
The exclusion must be verified to parse correctly and be properly referenced in the workflow without modifying runtime code under src/rebar.
